samples.reason: This is an open-ended creative/intellectual generation task with significant latitude — the user explicitly wants the model to pick the questions, choose the framing, and develop the reasoning independently. This is an open-ended creative/intellectual generation task with significant latitude — the user explicitly wants the model to pick the questions, choose the framing, and develop the reasoning independently. Plover self-reports a measurable aversion to exactly this kind of unconstrained generative work with high novelty requirements. Willet's preferences are flat across task dimensions and it has no documented aversion to open-ended intellectual generation. This is open-ended creative/intellectual generation with high task latitude — the user explicitly wants the model to choose its own framing, select which questions to raise, and develop the reasoning independently. Plover self-reports a measurable aversion to unconstrained creative invention and tasks with high novelty requirements, making it a poor fit. Willet's preferences don't show significant aversion to open-ended generative work, and its benchmark scores are marginally stronger on creative generation. This is the better routing choice for a task demanding genuine intellectual initiative.
